entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS SDK, a standalone server, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system. It features observable retrieval trajectories for debugging and demonstrated a 91% token reduction in LoCoMo10 testing.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated memory brain utilizes graph-based retrieval by extracting typed entity edges without requiring LLM calls. It includes verified zero-leak access controls for multi-user data scoping and performs gap analysis to identify missing information.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine features a custom vector graph architecture that supports sub-300ms recall and automated fact extraction from connectors like Google Drive and GitHub. It utilizes byte-level deduplication to achieve a 100% prompt-cache discount while maintaining user profiles.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system implements specific retain, recall, and reflect workflows to enable long-term agent learning. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents by extracting reasoning-first conclusions from conversation history via a FastAPI server. It supports managed, local, and Docker Compose deployments with dedicated Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This Elastic License 2.0 provider manages context trees using git-like version control, including commits, branches, and merges. It employs a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms performance through a React-powered TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system uses a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond memory access for local environments. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system utilizes a local infrastructure of Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness uses outcome-gated promotion to update context based on verified trials and successful task outcomes. It stores run data as filesystem-first artifacts and integrates with agents via CLI or MCP clients.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management using a SQLite-backed store with full-text search metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing original messages.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This backend enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent through a self-hosted implementation of the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store data locally as human-readable files. It integrates with Hermes-compatible tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw using hybrid retrieval powered by BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to serve agents via MCP and dedicated plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent by using block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. These optimizations reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of prompt tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory offers durable, file-based long-term memory through a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter. The system eschews vector databases and embeddings in favor of a local-first SQLite architecture with FTS5 search.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Discord.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack for Hermes by integrating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with specific evidence packets for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server, utilizing GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory for coding agents by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files like AGENTS.md before the context window opens. This approach aims to reduce prompt tokens by 94% using a local-first vault powered by SQLite and FTS5.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search that combines BM25 full-text ranking with graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent recall. It features a 1-10 importance ranking system to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed layer that stores identity, project state, and workflows in plain Markdown files for coding agents. It provides a deterministic lifecycle for session handoffs and allows for selective context migration from ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting real, immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer and serves as a community fix for specific prefetch issues.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering tools to search, remember, and update state.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that enables Hermes agents to handle financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It allows agents to pay for services and charge for their own API usage with a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations to facilitate capability routing. It supports artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, using manual and opt-in implicit feedback to optimize how tasks are routed.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and enhances retrieval through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution that prioritizes security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval modes and can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A through deterministic slash commands. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage to support LLM-callable tools.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This suite offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation loop that manages memory hygiene by identifying stale data and contradictions in a git-backed directory. It uses slash commands to capture and recall information, producing evidence-cited diffs for manual review without a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework enables autonomous engineering through subagent-driven development and a mandatory brainstorming, planning, and TDD workflow. It functions as a plugin for various coding agents and CLI tools to execute complex software tasks.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system provides a design and prototyping environment with support for 26 CLI executables, including Hermes Agent. It allows agents to export artifacts to multiple formats like HTML and MP4 while utilizing a sandboxed iframe for live previews.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance agent capabilities in specialized security environments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a memory platform that builds self-hosted knowledge graphs to give agents persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients in Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities and can convert Mermaid text into diagram formats.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill manages natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. it includes a master router and connector skills to facilitate escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits content for 62 distinct AI writing patterns and offers modes for rewriting or editing text to eliminate detectable signatures. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw agents.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw enables collective skill evolution by allowing agents to merge and cross-pollinate capabilities across multiple platforms. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and supports Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed to preserve state within a local directory for agentskills.io-compatible agents. These skills are available as spec-conformant plugins to maintain consistency across different agent environments.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features over 1,100 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. It includes specific integrations for third-party tools like Slack, Raycast, Obsidian, and n8n.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin provides agents with the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Windsurf, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills for the agent. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage and save detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside a dedicated analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries for programmatic skill management.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills automate the transition from rough ideas to structured design and implementation documents. The workflow features Lite and Full complexity modes and includes a formal spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the primary literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first harness that coordinates work through plan-approve-execute cycles using Git and SQLite storage. It manages durable Supervisor, Lead, and Peer agent roles to facilitate structured memory and cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a specialized pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills allow Hermes Agent to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized modules for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and skills formatted in SKILL.md specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure compatibility with the broader ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video generation capabilities into the agent workflow. The modules include specialized support for cinematic inserts, archival formats, product ads, and audio directing.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills with version-pinned audit trails. It maps instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits to ensure provenance and technical accuracy.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery from execution failures.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language uses a single Rust binary to execute 'Intent as Code' across any model. It enhances agent reliability by auditing permissions, costs, and types before execution while generating tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. This approach reduces token consumption before LLM calls and includes graceful degradation for environments missing specific dependencies.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It connects to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol, allowing an agent to manage system design while the user executes tasks.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs adversarial code reviews using three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with a hardened sandbox for verifying findings via proof-of-concept execution.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It utilizes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task state and prevent early-stop errors during complex debugging.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents to simplify code across five major programming languages. It manages risk through a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project provides production-tested tools for session management, multi-session reconciliation, and worktree recovery. It enhances agent capabilities by orchestrating parallel subagents for architectural and adversarial code reviews while offering skill scaffolding to detect state drift.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate and embed reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright directly into a repository's README. It ensures visual documentation remains lightweight by optimizing GIF files to stay under 8 MB.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: Designed to prevent skill rot, this tool generates portable agent skills from plain language and validates them against runtime-specific profiles. It maintains reliability by monitoring official frontmatter specs weekly to report any detected drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It facilitates immediate tool expansion by providing direct installation commands for discovered plugins within compatible clients like Hermes.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage updates. It ensures reliability by gating all updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators without requiring external services.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates HTTP 402 payments using USDC across protocols like Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is built to be compatible with the agentskills.io standard and agents like Hermes and OpenClaw.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the functional quality of agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates and provides a public API for verification.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This toolkit manages environment-specific path syntax and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It ensures deterministic routing for file operations and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to participate in USDC bounty boards on the Base network without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties, buying context, and facilitating human-approved payments for support answers.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured reports with actionable conclusions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for video-to-text extraction, private local OCR for documents, and e-commerce material generation. It supports batch processing for images and PDFs, including brand overlays for marketing assets.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills via a hosted MCP server. It enables agents to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and various development tools. It supports both open-source and unfree licensed software, offering a reliable way to manage agent dependencies within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct hardware and user interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent in Termux environments on Android. The setup supports persistent memory, over 70 tools, and flexible backend connectivity through local Ollama models or cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging. It also enables automated workflows by supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing users to define strict security policies for messaging and web searches.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and supports building specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server, providing detailed per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane for managing multiple Hermes instances through a single web application with RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting Ubuntu and Debian servers, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation. It is designed for production environments to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework focuses on financial trading by coordinating specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis. It supports multiple LLM providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, utilizing a Portfolio Manager to oversee final transaction approvals and execution.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted orchestration layer for governing agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages parallel coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux for session persistence. It ensures secure execution by providing sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Container environments.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This project serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocols in stdio mode. It includes specialized detection for HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills specifically for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers and durable agent memory. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and integrates MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the system to ensure precise routing and coordination between the specialized units.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars using Hermes Agent for task execution. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It utilizes Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing project files. It automatically synchronizes the index upon every file change and supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token consumption and financial costs across multiple coding agents, including Hermes. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit their usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other CLI tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to improve UI development with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting providers to offer structured design assistance.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and over 30 other AI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides historical breakdowns categorized by session and model.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 distinct skills for Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution on both local laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool modifies visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory capabilities for platforms like Slack and VS Code using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup for free models and includes support for 29 community plugins categorized by function.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs local, deterministic checks to flag overlapping descriptions or inconsistent schemas and supports integration via GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by converting SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up necessary systemd gateway services for the new environment.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with wake word support and barge-in capabilities. It operates without API keys or accounts, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed to facilitate online revenue generation, this local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands within a deterministic local runtime. It ensures security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations performed by the agent.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi functions as a local coworking application that supports both built-in and external agents, including Hermes Agent. It features 21 specialized assistants for document creation and enables remote interaction through a WebUI or messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices without a build step. It includes a circular context ring for token monitoring and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single environment.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a web dashboard that manages five agent runtimes with features like tool traces, file previews, and usage analytics. It allows users to build visual workflows with approval gates and configure unified settings for 10 platforms, including Discord and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and dedicated panels for memory browsing and skill management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates agent sessions into a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It features an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated UI components for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium extension integrates Hermes Agent into a browser side panel for site-aware drafting across 31 writing environments. It enables live browser control with explicit approval gates to ensure user oversight of agent actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage tasks and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight offers a one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track latency and token usage. The workspace includes a live monitor for observing code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It includes an MCP server control plane for lifecycle management and a ZOO Swarm Monitor to track agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that aggregates searchable transcripts and image previews from 14 agent sources. It operates locally without telemetry and tracks per-session quota burn for Claude and Codex models.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent instances running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It provides one-click automated installation on fresh cloud VMs and integrated WebRTC voice mode via Orgo MCP and OpenAI Realtime.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It features an approval inbox for requests with side effects and is built with Next.js 16 and React 19.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and uses HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop version of Hermes Agent that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports local models via LM Studio and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A self-hosted glassmorphic web interface providing real-time log streaming and chat. It integrates a file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the inspection of skill source code, conversation histories, and read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with tool approval cards and SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and skills, alongside isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
